note: Components whose performance or correctness the whole app depends on. A protected component needs an approved design (docs/design/<name>.md, R-024) once its folder exists, and a change under its path gets a specialist review (manifest review.specialists). Add a row when a component becomes this critical.

components.reason: Rows of hundreds of items on a TV with little memory: virtualised and paged, bounded memory while scrolling, predictable focus movement, every observer and timer cleaned up.
Owns media elements, listeners and requests; a leak or an unhandled error here ends the session on a TV.
